a.lede: Apache has released security updates to address a critical Roller flaw that threat actors are exploiting to gain code execution on vulnerable servers. [...]
a.title: Apache warns of Roller RCE vulnerability exploited in attacks

b.lede: Two critical NGINX vulnerabilities dubbed "nginx2root" allow unauthenticated attackers to execute code remotely on vulnerable web servers, with researchers demonstrating how the flaws can be chained with a Linux kernel bug to gain root access. [...]
b.title: Critical NGINX ‘NGINX2Root’ bugs let attackers hijack servers
